tickets.text: D sits 0.1% under the last swing high: one close short of the C5 new high, not past it. An hourly close over pivot_high is a mere return to the pivotal point, which C19 says is not resumption. I take it only on a daily close above the last confirmed pivot high; until then it is a test, not a trend resumption.

livermore: C5 buys the new high itself and never waits for a lower entry, so 'after a tight pause' is not my condition; W still 7.1% under its swing high is the level that must clear. Danger signal is my translation via atr_14d (1 atr fade from the day's high), not Livermore's literal 6 points (C7, R2).

D 3.2% under the last swing high with H1 below EMA9 at 31% of range is a pause inside the trend, not a new high (C5). An hourly close over pivot_high is a return to the pivotal point, not the C19 resumption. I want a daily close at a new 52-week closing high before this counts.

D 1.0% under the last swing high with mp FADING/DECELERATING: the trend is not yet resuming on my read (C18 analogue, R3). An hourly close over pivot_high is a return to the pivotal point, not the C19 resumption; the new high must be a daily close at a new 52-week closing high.
